4949 Surophoinissa {soo-rof-oy'-nis-sah}

源自 4948 及與 5403 同源字的組合; 陰性專有名詞

欽定本 - Syrophenician 1; 1

敘利腓尼基人 = "高貴的棕梠"
1) 混合種族的名稱, 一半是腓尼基人和一半是敘利亞人 (#可7:26|)

4949 Surophoinissa {soo-rof-oy'-nis-sah}

from a compound of 4948 and the same as 5403;; n pr f

AV - Syrophenician 1; 1

Syrophenician = "exalted palm"
1) the name of a mixed nation, half Phoenicians and half Syrians

same.cexp: 敘利亞非尼基〔敘利腓尼基〕的婦女（#可 7:26|）
